title: Moana (2016 film)
blurb: A none-too-bright rooster who stows away on Moana's canoe and survives the entire voyage more through luck than sense.
facts: Its songs were written by Lin-Manuel Miranda, Opetaia Foaʻi, and Mark Mancina, who also composed the score.
Set in ancient Polynesia, the film follows Moana (Cravalho), the strong-willed daughter of a village chief, who is chosen by the ocean to restore a mystical relic to the goddess...
When a blight threatens her island, she sets sail in search of Maui (Johnson), a legendary demigod, in hopes of saving her people.
